definitions.explanation: Describes a stabbing or grinding pain, especially in the stomach.
Describes something wound, tied, or stretched very tight.

examples.japanese: ⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧きりきり⟦{痛|いた}む→痛む：03008_itamu⟧。
examples.english: My stomach hurts with a sharp pain from stress.

examples.japanese: きりきり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
⟦{緊張|きんちょう}する→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧きりきり⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{食欲|しょくよく}→食欲：03249_shokuyoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧なくなる。
examples.english: When I get nervous, my stomach hurts with sharp pains and I lose my appetite.

examples.japanese: ネジ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧きりきり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{締|し}める→締める：10057_shimeru⟧。
examples.english: Tighten the screw as tight as possible.

examples.japanese: ⟦スケジュール→スケジュール：03850_sukejuuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧きりきり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{余裕|よゆう}がない→余裕がない：17325_yoyuuganai⟧。
examples.english: The schedule is so tight there's no room to spare.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧きりきり{舞|ま}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{忙|いそが}しさだった。
examples.english: At year-end, I was so busy I was run off my feet.

notes:
TYPE: Mimetic word (giongo/gitaigo) representing sound or sensation.

SENSE 1 - PAIN:
- Describes sharp, stabbing pain
- Often associated with stomach (⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧) or head (⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧)
- きりきり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{痛|いた}む→痛む：03008_itamu⟧ is the most common pattern
- Suggests stress-related pain

SENSE 2 - TIGHTNESS:
- Suggests extreme tightness or tension
- Can refer to physical tightness (rope, screw) or metaphorical (schedule, budget)
- きりきり⟦{舞|ま}い→舞う：04573_mau⟧: being extremely busy, spinning around

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧きりきり⟦{痛|いた}む→痛む：03008_itamu⟧ (stomach has sharp pains)
- きりきり⟦{舞|ま}い→舞う：04573_mau⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be run off one's feet)
- きりきり⟦{締|し}める→締める：10057_shimeru⟧ (to tighten completely)

SIMILAR PAIN EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦ずきずき→ずきずき：05262_zukizuki⟧: throbbing pain
- ⟦ちくちく→ちくちく：05372_chikuchiku⟧: pricking pain
- ⟦しくしく→しくしく：05373_shikushiku⟧: dull aching pain
